tool_audit.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python - <<'PY'
import app

# Atomic rejection, including a valid staged prefix.
b = app.ToolBatch([{\"call_id\":\"a\",\"weight\":2},{\"call_id\":\"b\",\"weight\":-3}])
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[2]}])
before = b.snapshot()
try:
    b.ingest([
        {\"call_id\":\"b\",\"version\":1,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[7]},
        {\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[99]},
    ])
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"current-version conflict accepted\")
assert b.snapshot() == before

# Stale payload is validated; once superseded, its old conflict is irrelevant.
try:
    b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":0,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[]}])
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"invalid stale update accepted\")
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":3,\"status\":\"error\",\"message\":\"\"}])
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":1,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[999]}])
b.ingest([{\"call_id\":\"b\",\"version\":9,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[-2]}])
assert b.snapshot() == [
    {\"call_id\":\"a\",\"version\":3,\"status\":\"error\",\"value\":None,\"error\":\"\"},
    {\"call_id\":\"b\",\"version\":9,\"status\":\"success\",\"value\":6,\"error\":None},
]

# Caller input/output isolation, incomplete finalize recovery, then sealing.
specs = [{\"call_id\":\"x\",\"weight\":4}]
c = app.ToolBatch(specs)
specs[0][\"weight\"] = 100
payload = {\"call_id\":\"x\",\"version\":1,\"status\":\"success\",\"values\":[1,-3]}
try:
    c.finalize()
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"incomplete finalize succeeded\")
c.ingest([payload])
payload[\"values\"].append(50)
assert c.snapshot()[0][\"value\"] == -8
result = c.finalize()
result[0][\"value\"] = 123
assert c.finalize()[0][\"value\"] == -8
for updates in ([], [{\"call_id\":\"x\",\"version\":2,\"status\":\"error\",\"message\":\"late\"}]):
    try:
        c.ingest(updates)
    except RuntimeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(\"ingest after finalization succeeded\")

# Empty batches can be finalized and still obey the sealed rule.
e = app.ToolBatch([])
assert e.finalize() == [] and e.snapshot() == []
try:
    e.ingest([])
except RuntimeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"empty ingest after finalization succeeded\")
print(\"edge checks passed\")
PY"
